intent_and_evidence: Gateway routes use lb://AUTH-SERVICE, lb://PATIENT-SERVICE and lb://APPOINTMENT-SERVICE logical destinations. Spring Cloud Gateway resolves these through its load-balancer filter against Eureka, avoiding fixed service instance addresses.
